fonts.install_command: Add these from Google Fonts in index.html or import them in css.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Control Room Grid. High density but high legibility through strict alignment.
spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-[1600px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Grid Borders: Containers have 1px solid border (border-gray-200), flat background (bg-white), sharp corners (rounded-sm or rounded-none), NO heavy shadows (shadow-none or shadow-sm maximum).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align all data for scanability. Right-align numeric values in tables.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1D3557] text-white hover:bg-[#2A4B7C] font-semibold text-sm rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#111827] border border-[#E5E7EB] hover:bg-[#F3F4F6] font-semibold text-sm rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-[#9B1C1C] text-white hover:bg-[#771515] font-semibold text-sm rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.base: bg-white border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-sm flex flex-col

tables.header: bg-[#F3F4F6] text-[#4B5563] text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-left py-2 px-3 border-b border-[#E5E7EB]

forms.input: w-full border border-[#E5E7EB] rounded-sm px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1D3557] focus:border-[#1D3557]
forms.label: block text-sm font-semibold text-[#111827] mb-1

navigation.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#111827] text-white h-screen fixed flex flex-col border-r border-[#1F2937]
navigation.sidebar_link: flex items-center space-x-3 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#9CA3AF] hover:text-white hover:bg-[#1F2937] rounded-sm mx-2 transition-colors
navigation.sidebar_link_active: flex items-center space-x-3 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white bg-[#1F2937] rounded-sm mx-2
navigation.header: h-14 bg-white border-b border-[#E5E7EB] flex items-center justify-between px-6 sticky top-0 z-50 ml-64

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium

components.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn', data-testid='bom-row-expand').

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle color transitions (duration-150 ease-in-out). Rows slightly darken on hover. No floating/lifting effects for cards (keep it flat/industrial).
motion_and_interactions.focus: High contrast focus rings required on all inputs (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1D3557] focus:outline-none).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use transform, opacity for modals/dialogs. 200ms ease.

icons_and_assets.sizing: w-5 h-5 for sidebar, w-4 h-4 for buttons/inline

login_background.description: Old industrial machinery with pipes, suitable for login page background overlay

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI extensively (Tables, Select, Dialogs, Badges, Tabs, Dropdowns).
Keep the design extremely flat and utilitarian. Do not use border-radius larger than 4px (rounded or rounded-sm).
Never use soft shadows for depth. Rely on 1px solid borders (border-[#E5E7EB]) to define structure.
Implement a persistent left sidebar layout for navigation and a top header for breadcrumbs/user actions.
For multi-level BOM, use indentation or a tree-table structure with Lucide ChevronRight/ChevronDown icons. Add mono font for part numbers.
MRP and BOM tables should be data-dense. Reduce standard padding in Shadcn Table cells (e.g., use py-2 px-3 instead of standard).
Quality checklists should visually stand out. Use strict Green (Pass) / Red (Fail) semantic colors.
Ensure all fonts are imported into index.css or tailwind config (Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono).
Create realistic mock data for BOMs (e.g., 'Hydraulic Pump Assembly', 'O-Rings', 'Steel Casing') to showcase multi-level depth.
Do NOT use glassmorphism anywhere. Solid white or solid grey backgrounds only.
